start: Exercise page of a barbell lift, member with Plus, Plates and bars set up, recent sets logged

user_sees: Screen '1-rep max' with the exercise name
Weight and reps filled, 'Filled in from your best recent set.'
must_not: Empty boxes when recent sets exist
An easy-week set used to fill the boxes

user_sees: Rows 95 % down to 50 % with 'Weight' and 'Plates per side'; light rows read 'Bar only'
must_not: A weight the member's plates cannot make

steps.action: Tap 'Change plates', change the plates, come back
user_sees: The table rounded to the new plates
Empty boxes and 'Type a weight and reps to see your 1-rep max.'

must_not: A table before both boxes are filled

start: Calculator open; then a member without Plus

user_sees: 'Reps must be a whole number from 1 to 100.'
The estimate and 'Over 12 reps the estimate is less exact.'

steps.action: As a member without Plus (and no gym plan), open the calculator link

start: Member's Plus ends; a gym member's plan becomes active

steps.action: Plus or the free month ends, open the calculator
must_not: The calculator still open after the plan ended

steps.action: A gym member whose plan is active opens it
must_not: The Plus screen for a member whose gym plan gives every paid feature
